intro: Tell apart descriptive information, opinion and a concrete fact in a cultural text. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Tell apart descriptive information, opinion and a concrete fact in a cultural text. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: frequency adverbs and contrast connectors add nuance to a usual description. In this passage, «marché» means «market».

frases.estudio: Chaque dimanche, le marché de la place attire les habitants des villages voisins.
frases.alumno: Every Sunday, the market in the square attracts people from the nearby villages.

frases.estudio: On y trouve du fromage, des légumes et des objets fabriqués dans la région.
frases.alumno: There you can find cheese, vegetables and objects made in the region.
